limitations: Coverage is all 19 direct production reference-cache operations and 9 related declared target-pair constructors on the pinned source. It excludes target-pair clones in unrelated consumers, other caches/printing/inference/composition and semantic workers.
Empty/moved/reused/borrowed sites are distinct. Existing vector items/capacity on a move are retained storage, not fresh allocation.
System allocation requests are recorded only inside the original primitive key constructor. Map bucket growth and diagnostic-only frame copies are separate.
Construction and map/delegate clocks contain observation/codegen/scheduling effects. Counts and cumulative requested bytes are not normal CPU shares, avoided cost or saved wall.
Full corpus equality uses counters disabled; enabled observation is qualified by real application/public/pool controls and actual Rust omission tests.
Observed loaded/config input snapshots omit embedded libraries, unsuccessful resolver queries and transient inputs. Native complete-project performed-work equivalence remains unproved.
Native public failures remain failed comparisons; reference state/publication qualification and mapper-context repair remain separate prerequisites.
